differences: Section count differs: original has 6 sections, generated has 4 sections.
Left closed-door section differs: original has 2 tall doors, generated has 3 tall doors.
Open-shelf section differs in proportion and internal count: original section is narrower with 4 vertical shelf bays, generated section is much wider with 7 vertical shelf bays.
Original splits the middle into separate S3 and S4 sections, while generated merges this area into one large mixed section.
Middle mixed/panel structure differs: original has one narrow column plus two large lower panels across two sections, generated has a 2x2 grid of four panel-like compartments in one section.

Right-side mixed/closed area differs: original has one mixed section with a small lower panel plus a separate narrow 2-door closed section; generated has a single mixed section with stacked compartments and only one narrow tall door.
Section proportions across the full unit are substantially different, especially center and right sections.
summary: The generated cabinet does not match the original wireframe because both the section layout and the counts/arrangement of doors, shelves, and panels are materially different.
